summary_1line: Bhishma begins a tale where Indra questions a loyal parrot that refuses to abandon its withered home tree, illustrating compassion and gratitude.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone parrot clings to the hollow of a withered, leafless tree struck by a poisoned arrow in a silent forest.
Indra disguised as a Brahmana stands beneath the dead tree speaking to the frail parrot perched in its hollow.
The forest tree pierced by a hunter’s poisoned arrow begins to wither as leaves and fruits fall around it.
